intensive glycemic control in type 2 diabetes is associated with a reduction in major vascular disease and mortality, irrespective of absolute risk and irrespective of region, and that these effects are independent of the effects of blood pressure lowering and other interventions.

the benefits of intensive glycemic treatment with gliclazide were similar in Asia, Europe and Eastern Europe.
